people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: Isaiah the prophet cried to Yahweh; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.
translations.bsb: So Isaiah the prophet called out to the LORD, and He brought the shadow back the ten steps it had descended on the stairway of Ahaz.
translations.kjv: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
translations.asv: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto Jehovah; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the dial of Ahaz.
